module: Flowgraph node "Set ScatterSky" (category dynamic_instant). Sets the sky brightness (skyBrightness) and the ScatterSky gradient textures (colorize, sunScale, ambientScale, fogScale, night, nightFog; hidden string pins). The original values are stored at start and restored on stop (data.restoreScatterSky).
notes: After applying, the node rereads then rewrites the time (getTimeOfDay/setTimeOfDay) to force the sky to update.
The gradient pins are all applied even if empty (nil value).

_executionStarted.desc: Stores the current brightness and the six gradient files.

_executionStopped.desc: Restores the stored values if data.restoreScatterSky is true.

work.desc: In repeat mode, applies the parameters every frame.

setScatterSkyParameters.desc: Calls the core_environment setters (setSkyBrightness, set*GradientFile) then reapplies the current time.
